summary: Porsche Auto Funding LLC, as depositor, and Porsche Financial Services, Inc., as sponsor, filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Underwriting Agreement dated September 23, 2026 with Wells Fargo Securities as representative of the underwriters, covering $911,000,000 aggregate principal balance of Class A-1, A-2a, A-2b, A-3 and A-4 notes issued by Porsche Financial Auto Securitization Trust 2026-1. Expected closing September 30, 2026. This is a routine auto-loan ABS securitization shelf takedown under Form SF-3, not a special situation; watch for collateral performance and spread pricing on the new-issue auto ABS.
